topics.topic: Authoritative time source for creating PublicationMark.marked_at
questions: What authoritative source supplies the fresh instant written to `marked_at` when the first publication mark is created?
What authoritative time source supplies `marked_at` when the deliverer creates a publication mark?

quotes:
The system clock is the one source of the current time, declared as `rules.time_source_policy`
   and reaching code through `system_clock_backend` as the operation `utc_now`.

Only a mark reads it, once, after the token, the request form and the identifiers are accepted and
   before the connection is examined or the project lock is taken. A mark refused before that point does
   not read it. A mark refused after it, and a replayed mark, have read it and write nothing. Scan, delivery
   and the health answer never read it.

The current time is a `datetime` in UTC without an offset, with microsecond precision and no
   rounding, written in ISO 8601 form as `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS`, followed by `.` and six digits when
   the microseconds are not zero, with no offset. Every instant of a record and an answer is written
   so. It sets `marked_at`.
judgement.why: This asks the same authoritative-clock question as P5, and the passages deciding it have not changed.

topics.topic: Scope of forbidden photo-tree access, including descendants and directory traversal to an exempt connections file
questions: Does “a file in it” include files at every depth and openings of descendant folders, or only direct child files of the photo folder?

If the configured connections file is located inside the project's photo folder, does opening directories solely to reach that file count as a forbidden opening of the photo folder, or is the entire traversal needed for the mandatory connection-file read exempt?

quotes: A scan covers the photo folder and all its subfolders (R0-12).

Each scan, placement and mark reads the connections file exactly once, at its connection check,
   and uses that reading for the whole operation.

INV-10: scan, placement and mark each answer the CONNECTION_NOT_CONFIRMED member of = models.RefusalCode for an unconfirmed connection; with every opening of the photo folder of that connection and of a file in it other than the connections file recorded, none is recorded, and no stored image, placement record or mark record is written (`test_an_unconfirmed_connection_delivers_nothing`).
judgement.why: A witness is missing because the draft assumes an unconfirmed operation may continue into descendant photo-tree access and that reading a configured file necessarily opens each ancestor directory, neither of which the texts make admissible.

topics.topic: Whether the connections-file exception is based on pathname, file identity, aliases, or role
questions: Does this exception cover only the single opening required for the connection check, every opening through the configured pathname, or every alias or hard link to the same filesystem object?
Is the connections-file exception determined by the configured pathname, by the opened file's identity, or by its content or role, especially when hard links or aliases exist?

quotes:
Each scan, placement and mark reads the connections file exactly once, at its connection check,
   and uses that reading for the whole operation.

INV-10: scan, placement and mark each answer the CONNECTION_NOT_CONFIRMED member of = models.RefusalCode for an unconfirmed connection; with every opening of the photo folder of that connection and of a file in it other than the connections file recorded, none is recorded, and no stored image, placement record or mark record is written (`test_an_unconfirmed_connection_delivers_nothing`).
judgement.why: A witness is missing because the proposed second alias opening occurs after the unconfirmed-connection refusal, while the texts authorize only the single connection-check reading and provide no admissible post-refusal photo traversal.

topics.topic: Whether INV-10 tests must prove that invalid or unconfirmed cases perform no photo-tree reads or opens
questions: For cleared confirmation, an unknown project, and every invalid-connections-file case, must the tests also show that no photo folder, subfolder, or source file is opened or read, rather than only that no durable state is written?

quotes:
Checks run in this order: token, request form and project id, connection, photo folder, source id,
   project lock, existing placement, named file.
Checks run in this order: token, request form and identifiers, connection, placement.
INV-10: nothing is scanned, placed or marked for a project unless the connections file read by that operation is valid and holds a confirmed connection for the project.

After a scan has succeeded on the running service, clearing the confirmation makes scan, placement and mark each answer the CONNECTION_NOT_CONFIRMED member of = models.RefusalCode and write nothing (`test_a_cleared_confirmation_stops_the_running_service`). For a valid file with no record for the project, scan, placement and mark each answer the UNKNOWN_PROJECT member of = models.RefusalCode and write nothing (`test_a_project_without_a_connection_delivers_nothing`). For an absent file, a file that cannot be opened, a file that is not UTF-8 or JSON, a file of another form and a record that breaks the form of rule 8, also when that record is unconfirmed or belongs to another project, scan, placement and mark each answer the FOLDER_UNAVAILABLE member of = models.RefusalCode and write nothing (`test_unreadable_connections_deliver_nothing`), and the service does not start (`test_the_service_does_not_start_with_an_unreadable_connection_record`).
judgement.why: A witness is missing because the proposed stale source read occurs after a connection refusal even though every operation orders the connection check before photo-folder or placement work, and no passage permits that post-refusal access.
